notes: POC focus: ticket/email summarization + auto-tagging into Zendesk macros; must integrate with existing triggers and workflows.
Customer quote on call: 'We need summaries agents can read in one glance — 3 lines max, plus recommended tags and macro IDs.'
Latency target: p95 < 600ms for single-message summarization when autoscaling; background bulk summarization can be batch-async.
Throughput: typical weekday steady-state 4k tickets/day, occasional spikes to 12k/day during product incidents — want graceful degradation not hard failures.
Quality bar: tag precision >= 90% for top-10 tags; fallback to human review queue if model confidence < 0.6.
Routing: prefer dedicated pool for production traffic, fallback to hosted smaller model in emergencies; need automatic fallback logic in routing policy.
Data controls: cannot send EU customer PII to non-resident region; must be able to restrict processing to EU or customer VPC.

Eval notes: ran Redwood hosted model and in-house distilled model on 2000 historical tickets; Redwood gave better contextual summarization, but cost needs tuning (quantization + batching recommendations requested).
Agent flow: suggested UI shows model summary + suggested tags + one-click macro insert; ambiguous cases show top-3 tag suggestions with confidence scores.
Integration stubs: Zendesk app will call Redwood API for create-ticket summarization; Freshdesk integration planned for phase 2.
requirements_summary: Primary: concise ticket/email summarization suitable for tier-1 agents (3-line TL;DR + key facts list)
Secondary: automated tag assignment to drive macros and routing (Zendesk triggers + ticket fields)
SLOs: p95 latency < 600ms, availability 99.9% during business hours, graceful fallback to smaller model or queueing under sustained spikes
Security: SSO/SAML for app access, audit logging for every inference, KMS-managed keys for customer data at rest
Deployment: private VPC for production traffic with optional on-premise worker for air-gapped customers in EU
Operations: ability to run canary model rollouts, per-route token cost visibility, and automatic rollback on quality regression
